jobs.title: Social Media Content Creator
jobs.description:
The Social Media Content Creator, part of our PR, Content, Social and Influencer Marketing team, is responsible for creating assets for use primarily in social media marketing (Instagram, Threads, Facebook, Pinterest, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, YouTube and more. Social media programs may be stand-alone programs within the agency, or they may be part of integrated marketing communications programs (advertising, content marketing, influencer marketing and public relations) requiring the Social Media Content Creator to collaborate with a team, align assets with the specific platform’s best practices and consider the overall look and feel of the brand and any active campaigns. An ideal candidate will excel at producing assets that can live across multiple digital properties in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities as Social Media Content Creator

Create visual content specifically for use across client social media platforms and other digital properties, including but not limited to email and blogs.
Conceptualize, create and edit content in a variety of formats, including images, carousels, infographics, GIFs and .mov/.mp4
Continually come up with new and innovative ideas for elevating pre-existing assets to further engage the intended audience
Articulate ideas and communicate proactively with the internal teams to determine visual design, messaging strategy and conceptual direction
Work efficiently to meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced social media environment (turnaround times can vary from a few hours to a few days or a few months)
Collaborate with the internal team to plan on-brand visuals that will engage digital audiences and align with the overall strategy
Proactively work with internal team to become knowledgeable about the brand, intended audiences, client expectations and project goals
Ensure content meets brand guidelines, and establish design consistency across each channel
Employ platform best practices to verify designs are optimized, sized and formatted correctly for specific channels and viewing devices
Work with the Social Media, Content and Creative teams to plan and shoot new content (photo and/or video) as needed to meet client expectations
Ensure work always meets timing and budget parameters and exceeds quality expectations

Additional Responsibilities as a Member of the PR/Content/Social/Influencer Team

Stay up to date with the latest social media, digital platform and industry trends, applications, technologies, channel updates and best practices
Assist with brainstorming and campaign development across the communications ecosystem

Communication Skills

Communicate in a clear, coherent and professional manner
Listen well and solve problems to achieve the most effective outcome for the client, team and agency
Develop strong relationships across the agency
Represent the team and Wray Ward in a positive manner in all endeavors

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in graphic design, interactive design or video production. If degree is outside design categories, candidate must show a proven understanding of graphic design principles and proven skills in editing
Presentation of portfolio commensurate with experience
1+ years of professional digital design experience, preferably in an agency environment
Strong conceptual thinking
Proficient in both photography and videography
Understanding graphic design principles (typography, color, layout, safe zones, etc.)
Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Lightroom and InDesign.
Familiarity with Canva, Figma and Monday.com is a plus
Knowledge of and some experience with best practices in content accessibility (e.g., Web Content Accessibility Guidelines, Adobe color contrast analyzers, captioning tools)
Ability to occasionally lift, carry and set up photography/video equipment.
Ability to stand, walk and work on location for extended periods when capturing content.
Understanding of Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, X and Pinterest and how visuals are used across the platforms (formats, sizes, minimum/maximum length)
Attention to detail and a passion for creating high quality work
Positive attitude and willingness to improve your craft
Ability to take constructive criticism with ease and grace
Simultaneously execute and prioritize multiple tasks at the same time
Strong organizational skills and proven track record to work across several business functions
This position requires occasional travel, typically translating to local and regional client content capture opportunities, as well as industry trade shows.

This job description serves as an overall summary of responsibilities for the position outlined. Please note it is subject to change with specific expectations associated with the position.

WE, NOT ME

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing - WEM
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

Role Overview: (remote US based)

Shape how Genesys defines, differentiates, and takes its Workforce Engagement Management (WEM) portfolio to market
, with ownership of a category narrative that connects product innovation to measurable customer and business value. This role will define Genesys' point of view on how AI, automation, agentic systems, and AI agents are changing workforce planning, quality, coaching, performance, and the relationship between human and virtual agents.

As a senior product marketing leader, you will translate a fast-evolving portfolio and roadmap into positioning that resonates with enterprise customers, analysts, partners, and sellers. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Pricing, Sales, and Marketing leaders to influence strategy, strengthen differentiation, and ensure innovation reaches the market with clear commercial value.

Your WEM expertise and AI fluency will help Genesys articulate how organizations can optimize increasingly blended workforces of human and AI-powered agents while improving employee experience, operational performance, and customer outcomes.
You will also build and develop a high-performing team of WEM product marketers, creating an environment where strategic thinking, collaboration, accountability, and ambitious ideas can thrive.

This role provides significant visibility across Genesys and the opportunity to influence enterprise go-to-market strategy, product direction, and the evolution of a critical technology category. Your work will help customers understand not only what Genesys Cloud delivers today, but how workforce technology can evolve as AI transforms the contact center.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the end-to-end WEM market narrative, positioning, value propositions, proof points, and differentiation across the portfolio, strengthening customer relevance and competitive advantage as the market evolves
Define Genesys' point of view on the future of WEM, translating advances in generative AI, agentic AI, automation, virtual agents, and AI-assisted workforce technology into a credible category vision
Shape a differentiated market story for blended human and AI-powered workforces, connecting workforce optimization to employee experience, operational performance, enterprise adoption, and customer outcomes
Influence product and go-to-market strategy through deep partnership with Product and Engineering, bringing customer, market, AI, and competitive insights upstream while positioning major roadmap milestones for commercial impact
Drive alignment with Product and Pricing on WEM packaging and go-to-market strategy, creating offers that customers can understand and sellers can confidently position, differentiate, and expand
Lead the competitive narrative across established WEM vendors, CCaaS competitors, and emerging AI-native players, identifying opportunities for Genesys to create meaningful and defensible market separation
Equip Sales and customer-facing teams to win across acquisition, migration, expansion, and AI transformation motions through compelling narratives, talk tracks, competitive guidance, objection handling, and customer proof
Amplify customer outcomes as market proof, demonstrating how organizations use WEM, automation, and AI to improve workforce effectiveness, employee experience, operational efficiency, and customer experience
Represent Genesys as a WEM thought leader with enterprise customers, industry analysts, partners, and industry forums, shaping external conversations about the evolution of workforce technology and AI
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of WEM product marketers, strengthening strategic capability, product marketing craft, accountability, collaboration, and commercial focus
Measure and continuously improve go-to-market effectiveness using customer insight, seller feedback, competitive intelligence, adoption data, pipeline signals, expansion performance, and market perception

Required Qualifications:

10+ years of B2B technology marketing experience, including significant product marketing leadership experience in enterprise software and demonstrated success building and leading high-performing teams
Significant experience in Workforce Engagement Management, Workforce Management, or contact center technology, with strong knowledge of WEM buyers, workflows, economics, use cases, and competitive dynamics
Deep expertise across core WEM disciplines, including workforce forecasting, scheduling, quality management, performance management, coaching, workforce analytics, and employee engagement
Strong fluency in generative AI, agentic AI, automation, virtual agents, AI-assisted quality and coaching, and the implications of increasingly blended human and AI workforces
Proven track record of owning positioning, messaging, product launches, and go-to-market strategy for complex enterprise technology portfolios
Strong commercial orientation with demonstrated experience connecting product marketing strategy to pipeline, adoption, seller effectiveness, competitive wins, customer expansion, or market perception
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity and exercise sound judgment as technologies, customer expectations, competitive dynamics, and product roadmaps evolve
Extensive experience influencing senior leaders and driving cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Pricing, and related functions
Exceptional executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate detailed WEM capabilities and emerging AI concepts into clear business value for technical, commercial, and C-suite audiences
Strong people leadership capabilities with a track record of developing talent, building trust, raising team performance, and creating accountability across complex organizations

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience shaping category strategy or market perception for WEM, CCaaS, workforce technology, customer experience, or adjacent enterprise software markets
Experience engaging directly with enterprise customers, industry analysts, strategic partners, or executive audiences on WEM and AI strategy
Experience influencing product packaging, pricing strategy, portfolio architecture, or commercial models for enterprise SaaS offerings
Demonstrated thought leadership on the evolution of workforce technology, AI-powered customer experience, or human and AI workforce orchestration

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Since 1843, The Economist Group has championed independence, excellence and openness, helping people understand and tackle the critical challenges shaping the world. Today, we are building on that legacy as a global media and information-services company powered by digital innovation, analytical rigour and evidence-based insight.

Across our three businesses - The Economist, Economist Enterprise and Economist Education - we deliver trusted analysis and insights to individuals and organisations in more than 170 countries. United by a shared purpose to drive progress, we empower decision-makers to make sense of change and chart a course through an increasingly complex world.

As a colleague, you will be part of a culture that values ideas, encourages ownership and holds itself to high standards. We invest in people who are curious, thoughtful and adaptable, whether they are launching new products, reporting on global events or harnessing emerging technologies such as AI to improve how we work. Here, fresh thinking is taken seriously, ambition is matched by integrity, and great work is recognised. Working across disciplines, geographies and perspectives, we are united by a commitment to innovation, excellence and creating meaningful impact.

Want to discover more about life at The Economist Group? Follow @EconomistCareers on Instagram to discover the people, stories and opportunities that make TEG unique.

The Paid Social Media Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, optimisation, and execution of our paid social media campaigns across multiple platforms. This position reports to the Head of Platform Partnerships and will work closely with various internal and external stakeholders to deliver high-performing campaigns. This position is focused on leveraging paid social strategies to enhance our B2B presence and distribute partnership content to designated audiences.

Objective/Purpose of the Role

The primary objective of the Paid Social Media Manager is to deliver strategic paid social campaigns that achieve projected KPIs for client-integrated campaigns within our NA region. This role involves developing and managing campaigns, analysing performance data and providing actionable insights. The Paid Social Media Manager will be leading campaigns across multiple social platforms to drive lead generation, brand awareness and engagement.

Responsibilities Of The Role

Campaign management

Develop, plan, set-up, and optimise paid social media campaigns across key platforms, including Meta, LinkedIn, X, and others such as YouTube and Reddit
Monitor and adjust targeting, bids, ad creatives, and landing pages to maximise ROI.
Conduct A/B testing on ad creatives and targeting options to improve performance.
Work closely with the media strategy team to deliver paid social campaigns that will meet preset client/agency objectives and engage target audiences to achieve KPIs

Performance Analytics and Insights
Define campaign KPIs and benchmarks for paid social media campaigns with allotted budget.
Translate complex campaign performance data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders through visually engaging presentation decks

Present campaign strategies and performance updates to both internal stakeholders and external clients with confidence and clarity
Stay updated on industry trends, algorithm changes, and best practices to maintain competitive advantage

Collaboration and Integration

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, bringing a proactive approach to communication and problem-solving
Work within the B2B marketing team to align social media strategies with broader digital marketing and business objectives
Collaborate with media leads, content leads, sales, and other marketing team members to ensure cohesive and effective campaign execution

Experience Required For The Role

Proven experience in a paid social media role, with a primary focus on managing paid campaigns from strategic ideation and setup through to execution, optimization, and reporting. Agency experience a plus

A track record of using data analysis to drive campaign optimisations, translate complex performance data into actionable insights, and present findings with confidence to stakeholders and clients.
Demonstrable experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, showing strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines.
Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including media strategy, content, and sales, to deliver cohesive and successful campaigns.

Skills Required For The Role

Platform Expertise: Deep, technical knowledge of paid advertising on key social media platforms, specifically Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, X (formerly Twitter), and YouTube.
Data & Analytics Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets, including the ability to create complex formulas, pivot tables, and data visualisations for performance reporting.
Content & Copywriting: Expertise in social media content curation and creation, including strong writing and editing skills tailored for different platforms and target audiences.
Proactive Industry Knowledge: A commitment to and curiosity for staying current on industry trends, algorithm changes, and emerging best practices in social media marketing.
Ability to work for a global company on a team that spans multiple time zones (occasional calls before or after normal work hours)

The expected base salary for this position is between $105k - $135k + bonus. It is not typical for offers to be made at or near the top of the range. Rather, salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, licensure or certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered

Working Arrangements

The majority of our roles operate on a hybrid working pattern, with 3+ days office attendance required.

AI usage for your application

We are an innovative organisation that encourages the use of technology. We recognise that candidates may utilise AI tools to support with their job application process. However, it is essential that all information you provide truthfully and accurately reflects your own experience, skills, and qualifications.

What We Offer

Our benefits package is designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work-life balance. It includes a highly competitive pension or 401(k) plan, private health insurance, and 24/7 access to counselling and wellbeing resources through our Employee Assistance Program.

We also offer a range of lifestyle benefits, including our Work From Anywhere program, which allows you to work from any location where you have the legal right to do so for up to 25 days per year. In addition, we provide generous annual and parental leave, as well as dedicated days off for volunteering and even for moving home.

You will also be given free access to all The Economist content, including an online subscription, our range of apps, podcasts and more.

jobs.title: SEO & AI Visibility Specialist
jobs.description:
About EAB

At EAB , our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data-driven insights and best-in-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.

At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards .

For more information, visit our Careers page.

The Role In Brief

SEO & AI Visibility Specialist

The SEO & AI Visibility Specialist will play a pivotal role in driving organic traffic growth and enhancing the online visibility of EAB’s higher education clients across both traditional search engines and AI-driven discovery platforms (e.g., Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Bing Copilot, Perplexity). This role bridges established SEO practices with emerging AI-driven search behaviors to ensure partner content is competitive, discoverable, and accurately represented across evolving digital experiences.

Responsibilities include advising partners, conducting audits, performing keyword and prompt research, and translating insights into actionable recommendations that improve both search performance and AI visibility while contributing to the continued evolution of EAB’s optimization discipline.

The role will be based in either Richmond, VA or Washington, D.C.

Primary Responsibilities

Compile and synthesize data across reporting platforms to evaluate performance and communicate impact to partners in higher education, educating partners and advocating for recommended changes.
Develop and guide SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies aligned to partner goals, with a primary focus on technical performance and discoverability.
Provide targeted recommendations to improve crawlability, indexation, structured data, and content to support both search engine rankings and AI-driven discovery.
Perform keyword and prompt research to inform on page optimization and content strategy.
Leverage analytics to interpret SEO and AI visibility performance, delivering insights that inform partner decisions and ongoing strategy refinement.
Stay current on SEO and AI-driven search trends, rapidly adopting new tools and methodologies to enhance analysis and recommendations, and contributing to evolving best practices and team knowledge.
Utilize tools such as Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, and emerging SEO/GEO platforms to extract insights that inform recommendations, demonstrating adaptability as toolsets evolve.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, information technology, communications or related field.
2 years of SEO experience. This includes a deep understanding of SEO principles and the ability to apply them in a strategic manner.
Working knowledge of emerging Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) principles and AI-driven search behavior.
Strong communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across teams and clear presentation of strategies and outcomes to stakeholders at all levels.
Experience in utilizing GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio
Exceptional analytical skills, with the ability to distill complex data into actionable insights and strategies. This includes a proficiency in evaluating SEO performance metrics to guide strategic decisions and optimize for results.
Strong creative aptitude, including an understanding of website design, information architecture, and content strategy.

Ideal Qualifications

Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint
Experience with SEO tools including SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, etc.
Direct response marketing and/or higher education experience
Commitment to embracing a continual learning environment and contributing to a dynamic and welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB’s mission, values, and aspiration.

If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome new perspectives and learn from each other’s unique experiences. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.

Compensation

The anticipated starting salary (base) range for this role is $62,500 - $71,500 per year. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting salary range for their role.

Benefits

Consistent with our belief that our employees are our most valuable resource, EAB offers a competitive and inclusive benefits package. Our benefits currently include:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; dependents and domestic partners eligible
20+ days of PTO annually, in addition to paid firm and floating holidays
Daytime leave policy for community service and flextime for fitness activities (up to 10 hours per month each)
401(k) retirement savings plan with annual discretionary company matching contribution
Health savings account, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending account, and pre-tax commuter plans
Employee assistance program with counseling services and resources available to all employees and immediate family
Wellness programs including gym discounts, incentives to promote healthy living, and family access to the leading app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation
Fertility treatment coverage and adoption or surrogacy assistance
Paid parental leave with phase back to work program for birthing and non-birthing parents
Access to milk shipping service to support nursing employees during business travel
Discounted pet health insurance coverage for dog and cat family members
Company-provided life, AD&D, and disability insurance
Financial wellness resources and membership in a robust employee discount program
Access to employee resource groups, merit-based advancement, and dynamic professional growth opportunities

Benefits kick in day one; learn more at eab.com/careers/benefits .

This opening is not eligible for visa sponsorship at this time; EAB will thus consider candidates who possess U.S. work authorization that does not require employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.

At EAB, we believe that to fulfill our mission to “make education smarter and our communities stronger” we need team members who bring a diversity of perspectives to the table and are committed to fostering a workplace where each team member is valued, respected and heard.

To that end, EAB is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we make employment decisions on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Title: Web Content Manager, Magnolia CMS/SEO

Contract Duration: 06 Months Contract

Role Summary

Own the strategy and day-to-day execution of web content across assigned company sites. This role manages content planning, governance, publishing and optimization in Magnolia CMS; partners with marketing and business stakeholders to translate needs into effective digital experiences; and uses performance data to improve organic visibility, engagement and conversion. The role also supports website enhancements and migrations and helps establish scalable processes, standards and priorities for web content operations.
Essential Functions

Develop and maintain web content strategies, priorities and roadmaps aligned with marketing and business objectives.
Manage content creation, publishing, maintenance and quality assurance in Magnolia CMS.
Serve as a website and page publisher accountable for accurate, current, accessible and brand-compliant content.
Partner with marketing teams and business stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify objectives, recommend solutions and establish project priorities and timelines.
Apply SEO, AEO and GEO best practices to page structure, metadata, internal linking and content development.
Use web analytics and reporting to evaluate organic visibility, engagement, conversion and content effectiveness; recommend and implement improvements.
Manage content governance, publishing workflows, documentation and training to support consistent execution.
Maintain and prioritize a backlog of content updates, enhancements and optimization opportunities.
Support website and CMS migration planning, including content inventories, audits, mapping, remediation, migration readiness and post-launch validation.
Coordinate web content workflows and integrations with related platforms such as Eloqua and Salesforce.
Lead small- to mid-sized web initiatives, monitor progress, identify issues and communicate recommendations and status to stakeholders.
Use AI tools appropriately to improve content analysis, development and workflow efficiency while maintaining professional review, accuracy and brand standards.

Education and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Digital Media or a related field, or equivalent training and experience.
Five or more years of experience managing web content, digital experiences or CMS-based publishing in a collaborative environment.
Demonstrated experience balancing web content strategy with hands-on execution, stakeholder consultation and project management.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication and organizational skills.

Technical Skills – Must Have

Hands-on experience managing and publishing web content in Magnolia CMS.
Proficiency with HTML and CSS for content formatting and basic troubleshooting.
Working knowledge of SEO best practices, including on-page optimization, metadata, internal linking and content structure.
Experience with AEO/GEO and optimizing content for AI-powered search and answer engines.
Experience using web analytics and reporting tools to evaluate content performance, engagement and conversion.
Ability to manage content governance, publishing workflows, quality assurance and accessibility standards.
Experience supporting website enhancements, content inventories and migration-related activities.

Technical Skills – Nice to Have

Experience integrating or coordinating web content with Eloqua and Salesforce.
Familiarity with conversion-rate optimization, testing and personalization tools.
Experience planning or supporting large-scale website or CMS migrations.
Working knowledge of digital asset management and image-optimization practices.
Experience using AI tools to improve content workflows, analysis and execution.

Success Measures

Accuracy, quality, accessibility and timeliness of published content.
Improvement in organic visibility, engagement and conversion for priority content.
Effective prioritization and delivery of the web content backlog.
Adoption of consistent governance, publishing and quality-assurance practices.
Readiness and successful execution of website enhancements or migration activities.

sits on the Data Analytics, Reporting & Strategy
team and serves as the analytical partner and lead for the Paid Media team. Paid Media drives company-wide digital media strategy, campaign management, and consultative support across AEG divisions, including AEG Presents, Global Touring, Festivals, Goldenvoice, Bowery Presents, and Global Partnerships. Advanced SQL skills and experience pulling, transforming, and analyzing large, complex datasets
Strong ability to build data models, data flows, and ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL and/or Python, bringing together data from multiple media channels into a scalable, automated insights reporting structure

Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (formerly Datorama) or similar marketing data integration platforms is a strong plus
Working knowledge of paid media data and performance metrics, including impressions, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS, across platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok

A successful candidate for this position will possess the following:

Detail oriented.

Ability to conceptualize, write and edit, accurate and concise content for university audiences.
Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, conduct multiple tasks and maintain effective working relationships.
Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
Ability to visually inspect print and online copy when self editing or editing the copy of others.

AWS is seeking a Senior Manager to lead the Cross-Category Services marketing team. This role owns the marketing strategy and execution for a portfolio of services that help AWS customers accelerate their cloud transformations and achieve long-term success: AWS Training & Certification, AWS Support, AWS Professional Services, and AWS Marketplace & Partner Services.

These services represent a critical part of the AWS customer journey — from building skills and getting expert guidance, to finding and deploying third-party solutions, to ensuring ongoing operational excellence. Together they generate billions in revenue.

As the leader of this team, you will build and manage a high-performing team of product marketers, develop differentiated positioning and messaging for each portfolio, drive customer insights that inform marketing strategy, and serve as the connective tissue between diverse business stakeholders who have different operating rhythms, go-to-market motions, and customer audiences.

This is a role for someone who thrives in complexity — someone who can context-switch fluidly across businesses while maintaining strategic coherence, who builds trust with senior stakeholders through intellectual rigor and consistent delivery.

Marketing Strategy & Execution

Develop and own the marketing strategy for Training & Certification, Support, Professional Services, and Marketplace — including positioning, messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market plans

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

We are seeking a Temporary Senior Manager, Lifecycle Marketing to join our team for an anticipated 6-month assignment, with the potential for an extension based on business needs. This role is expected to support approximately 30-40 hours per week.

Responsibilities

General Responsibilities include but not limited to:

Working closely with the VP, Growth & Digital, you will lead lifecycle campaigns and contribute to a broader range of digital marketing initiatives, from acquisition and discovery through booking, pre-arrival and repeat stays.

Email, SMS and CRM will be major areas of ownership, including our Klaviyo rollout and lifecycle roadmap. Alongside that work, you will actively support affiliate marketing, SEO, generative engine optimization (GEO), digital reporting and website conversion initiatives. These are ongoing parts of the role, with priorities set across the broader digital roadmap.

You will manage campaign planning, work directly with property teams and agencies, and personally build, test and launch initiatives. We’re looking for a versatile digital marketer with deep Klaviyo expertise, strong technical fluency and advanced practical AI skills who can move comfortably between strategy, analysis and execution.

Lifecycle strategy, email and SMS

Develop the lifecycle strategy and CRM roadmap across the brand and properties, including email and SMS. Partner with Klaviyo and developers on migration, data mapping and integrations.
Build and optimize email and SMS campaigns, segmentation and personalization using guest behavior, reservation history, preferences, engagement and loyalty status.
Plan how brand and property communications work together, including cross-property discovery, contact frequency and audience exclusions.
Build and optimize transactional, pre-arrival, welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-stay, repeat-stay and OTA-to-direct journeys.
Establish a testing program to improve conversion, retention and direct revenue.

Translate performance trends into a prioritized testing plan across messaging, audiences, offers, landing pages and booking experiences.
Maintain reliable campaign operations, including consent, suppressions, deliverability, tracking and QA; adapt HTML/CSS templates and dynamic content as needed.

Affiliate, search visibility and digital initiatives

Help identify and develop digital partnerships and audience-growth opportunities that bring qualified traffic and new guests into Viceroy’s marketing ecosystem.
Coordinate SEO and GEO initiatives with agencies and property teams: prioritize content opportunities, brief updates, track implementation and monitor search and AI visibility.
Support website, offer-page and booking journey improvements, including content updates, campaign landing pages and conversion testing.
Manage assigned digital projects, tracking owners, deadlines and dependencies through completion.

AI and workflow improvement

Use AI to accelerate campaign production, analysis, coding, QA, documentation and project management.
Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows and automations that improve execution speed and quality.
Apply sound judgment to AI outputs, maintaining accuracy, brand standards and responsible handling of guest data.
Identify opportunities to simplify manual work across corporate and property marketing teams.

Typically 6+ years of lifecycle and digital marketing experience, combining email and SMS expertise with experience contributing to broader acquisition, conversion or growth initiatives.
Deep, hands-on Klaviyo expertise across email and SMS, including automated journeys, segmentation, dynamic content, testing and reporting.
Experience implementing or migrating a CRM program and working across multiple brands, properties or business units.
Strong technical fluency with HTML/CSS, event-based marketing, data structures and integration troubleshooting; comfort working with APIs, webhooks and developers.

Strong analytical skills and experience with GA4, marketing dashboards and performance reporting.
Working knowledge of affiliate marketing, SEO and AI search visibility, with the ability to coordinate specialists and move projects forward.
Excellent project management, writing and quality-control skills.
Confidence working directly with property teams and balancing multiple stakeholders and deadlines.
A commercial mindset and a track record of improving conversion, retention or customer lifetime value.
Experience in hospitality, travel or luxury; familiarity with PMS and booking engine data, loyalty programs and reservation-triggered communications; and experience supporting a portfolio of brands or properties.

What Success Looks Like

A clear lifecycle roadmap and dependable progress across email, SMS and supporting digital initiatives.
Core transactional, email and SMS journeys launched, tested and continuously improved.
A coordinated campaign calendar with clear property accountability.
Actionable reporting that connects marketing activity to business results.
Affiliate, SEO/GEO and website initiatives delivered against agreed priorities, with measurable performance and clear next steps.
Documented processes and AI-assisted workflows that help the team scale.

Resume

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
SENIOR PRODUCT MARKETING MANAGER

Kansas City Metro Residents ONLY
On-site
Up to 25% Travel

WHO IS VINCUE

We're VINCUE, a founder-led automotive tech SaaS company based in Kansas City, and we've hit our inflection point. We're the fastest-growing supply chain innovator in the $750B automotive industry, backed by operators who've built and exited automotive tech before. In 2026 we closed a $93M growth round led by Wavecrest Growth Partners, with proven product-market fit, strong retention, and deepening adoption behind us.

We're big enough to attract game-changing partnerships while retaining our startup culture that rejects bureaucracy, corporate fluff, and any time-wasting nonsense. We move fast, but not recklessly. We think big, but execute with discipline. Our culture runs on authenticity, momentum, and putting people first.

If you've got a #GAMEON mentality and want to be the one who tells the story behind everything VINCUE builds, this is where you belong.

ABOUT THE MARKETING TEAM

VINCUE's marketing team is small, fast, and close to the business. We run trade shows from NADA to state association meetings, produce our annual user conference, VINCUE: UNLEASHED, run digital and account-based programs, and partner with a creative team that shoots, designs, and animates in house.

Our product team ships constantly. New features, new solutions, new products, and partner integrations. What we haven't had is one person whose whole job is making sure each of those lands with dealers, with our sales team, and with the market. That's this role.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

We're looking for a product marketer who wants to be more than the person who writes the launch email. We want someone who decides what a release means, who it's for, and why a dealer should care, then makes sure that story shows up everywhere. You'll be the bridge between what our product team builds and what dealers, our sales team, and the market need to hear.

You'll report to our CMO and work side by side with our product team. You'll partner closely with our Creative Director, who owns all visual branding, writing the briefs and stories that creative brings to life. You'll coordinate with our Marketing Manager and Digital Marketing Manager on all content and campaign execution, equip our sales team to sell every release, and work with Business Development on partner integration launches.

This is a senior individual contributor seat with real ownership. You'll be expected to push back on product, shape launch decisions, and hold the line on message quality.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

THE RIGHT MINDSET
You're a translator. You can sit in a product demo and walk out knowing exactly why a used car manager should care.
You start with the customer, not the feature list.
You have opinions and you defend them. You'll tell product when a launch isn't ready and tell sales when a message isn't landing.
You thrive on a small team where everyone pitches in, and "that's not my job" isn't in your vocabulary.
You measure your work by what it moves, like pipeline, win rates, and adoption, not by how many assets you ship.

THE EXPERIENCE
5+ years in product marketing, with at least 3 in B2B SaaS
A track record of launching products and features end to end, with results you can point to
Proven sales enablement work, including material reps actually used and teams you trained to sell
Experience briefing and directing creative teams across print, digital, web, and video
Automotive, dealer software, or multi-location B2B experience is a plus, but not required

THE SKILLS
Positioning and messaging. You can define what a product is, who it's for, and why it wins, in words a dealer would actually use.
Launch planning. You know how to tier a release and run a launch across product, sales, marketing, and creative without dropping a thread.
Sales enablement. You build talk tracks, demo narratives, objection handling, and battlecards that reps reach for on their own.
Customer interviewing. You run interviews and win/loss conversations that surface the real reason a dealer buys, stays, or leaves.
Competitive analysis. You know how to track competitors and turn what you learn into clear, usable comparisons.
Writing. You make technical features clear and compelling to non-technical buyers.
Creative briefing. You write briefs and storyboards that give designers, videographers, and animators what they need to do their best work.
Organization. You keep a messaging library and master files so clean that anyone on the team can find the current version in seconds.

BONUS POINTS
None of these are required, but they'll help you stand out:
Launching a major platform release or migrating existing customers to a new platform
Marketing to enterprise buyers or large multi-location groups
Partner or integration marketing
Input on pricing and packaging
HubSpot or a similar marketing platform

ROLE EXPECTATIONS

As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will:
Own positioning and messaging for every new feature, solution, product, and partner integration
Keep product messaging consistent with VINCUE's core platform story, tailored for single-rooftop dealers, large dealer groups, and OEM and partner audiences
Tier every release by impact and run launch plans with product, sales, creative, and marketing
Lead partner integration launches in coordination with Business Development and our partners
Make sure sales can sell what we ship before it ships, with talk tracks, demo narratives, objection handling, one-pagers, and decks
Train sales and account teams on new releases and keep enablement material current
Build ROI and business-case material for large dealer group opportunities
Track competitors and maintain battlecards and competitive comparisons
Talk to dealers regularly, run win/loss reviews, and feed what you learn back to product
Turn customer wins into case studies and proof points
Drive adoption of new features among existing customers with customer success and account management
Own all product content across print, digital, website, webinars, and video, writing the briefs and storyboards creative executes and approving final assets for message and product accuracy
Own the library of approved product messaging and master files for all product content
Measure launch results and report on what worked

PERFORMANCE PHILOSOPHY

You're measured on whether the market understands what we build and buys it, not on how many assets you ship.

In your first 90 days, you'll learn our platform, our customers, and our competitors, talk with at least 10 dealers, build our messaging library and launch framework, ship your first battlecards, and lead your first launch end to end.

Clear stories sell. Confident reps close. Dealers who use what we build stay.

TRAVEL & WORKING CONDITIONS

On-site at our Kansas City HQ when not traveling
Up to 25% travel for dealer interviews and trade shows

HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and a few work samples to work@vincue.com. Launch plans, messaging frameworks, enablement material, or campaigns you led are all great. If you can, include a sentence or two about a launch you're proud of and what you owned on it.

jobs.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.

Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.

Overall Purpose

The Director of Marketing Technology and Transformation is a member of the Marketing Operations team, whose mission is to enable our people to do the best work of their lives. This role leads improvement in how Marketing works and in the technology that supports Early Warning’s portfolio of brands, including Zelle, Paze, and Certos.

This role owns Marketing’s technology roadmap and leads work to simplify processes, automate repetitive work, and use AI responsibly. The Director works across Marketing and with Technology, Data, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and other teams to identify the most important problems to solve, recommend the right approach, and move solutions from idea through implementation and adoption.

As a hands-on transformation leader, the Director will identify opportunities for Marketing to operate faster and safely while increasing impact. This leader will take a network-first approach, creating shared processes, platforms, automations, and responsibly deployed AI capabilities that improve delivery across Marketing and advance our ambition to become an AI-native company.

The Director is responsible for making sure Marketing’s technology investments work together, solve clear business needs, and can support multiple brands where appropriate. This includes recommending when to improve an existing tool, integrate systems, build a new capability, buy technology, retire tools that are no longer delivering enough value, or use AI to increase Marketing’s bandwidth faster than headcount.

Essential Functions

Marketing Technology Strategy and Roadmap

Own and maintain Marketing’s multi-year MarTech technology roadmap across Zelle, Paze, Certos, and shared Marketing functions
Set clear priorities for technology improvements with a network-first approach, based on business need, expected value, cost, risk, ease of use, and ability to support Marketing priorities
Recommend when Marketing should improve an existing tool, integrate systems, build a capability, purchase new technology, or retire a tool
Develop business cases and funding recommendations for major technology investments and present recommendations and tradeoffs to senior leaders
Work with Technology, Data and Sales Operations to deliver the platforms and solutions needed for Marketing's CRM, brand health and campaign attribution initiatives

Process Improvement and Transformation

Lead efforts to improve the Marketing processes that have the greatest impact on speed, capacity, quality, cost, or risk
Map important processes from beginning to end to understand to identify friction points and redesign processes using automation, AI, reusable components, and self-service capabilities
Establish reusable processes, standards, platforms, and self-service capabilities across brands while preserving legitimate business, regulatory, and customer requirements
Define transformation success measures and track adoption, capacity creation, cycle-time improvement, cost savings, risk reduction, and other business outcomes

Reengineer How Marketing Works, Inclusive Of AI

Identify, prototype, and lead delivery of automations, AI-enabled workflows, integrations, and lightweight tools that improve speed, quality, or capacity
Partner with Legal, Risk, Technology, and enterprise AI teams to move promising solutions from discovery and minimum viable capability through testing, release, adoption, iteration while meeting security, privacy, and governance requirements
Support Marketing's contribution Marketing's contribution to Early Warning's AI-native ambition by working with internal and external partners to develop responsible, scalable AI enablement programs for marketers, reusing enterprise capabilities and standards wherever possible
Serve as Marketing’s lead for marketing technology and process transformation with senior leaders and cross-functional partners
Identify and prioritize practical uses of AI and automation that can reduce manual work, improve quality, increase capacity, or help Marketing make better decisions. Lead new solutions from initial idea and testing through approval, implementation, adoption, and broader use
Work with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Technology, and enterprise AI teams to make sure new capabilities meet security, privacy, legal, and governance requirements
Help establish common approaches, tools, and training so marketers can use AI responsibly in their everyday work
Manage key technology and vendor relationships, including vendor evaluation, selection, performance, cost, and ongoing value

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
Typically has 12 or more years of experience or demonstrated portfolio consistent with experience required of the role in marketing technology, marketing automation, product management, solutions architecture, process improvement, or related disciplines
Demonstrated experience developing multi-year strategies, roadmaps, investment cases, and executive recommendations for complex technology or transformation portfolios
Proven ability to develop business cases, evaluate technology investments, manage vendors, and communicate recommendations to senior leaders
Demonstrated leadership of complex, cross-functional teams and enterprise transformation initiatives, establish alignment across functions, and drive decisions without relying solely on formal authority
Effective communication and presentation skills, with demonstrated ability to translate complex technology and transformation topics into clear business implications, investment choices, risks, and recommendations

Preferred Qualifications

Experience modernizing marketing technology or operations in a regulated, high-control, or complex enterprise environment
Demonstrated use of generative AI, decision automation, or intelligent workflow tools to solve real business-process problems
Product-management, process-improvement, change-management, architecture, or agile delivery training or certification

Act as a temporary replacement for Portfolio Sales and Marketing Managers during their time off, ensuring the completion of essential weekly tasks and serving as the primary point of contact for onsite teams.
Participate in the development, deployment and maintenance of leasing and marketing tools, strategies, strategy documents, workflows, SOPs, training deliverables and other operational materials.
Participate in the testing of new tools, workflows and SOPs and provide quality control feedback on new and existing processes.
Provide exceptional customer service/assistance to communities and HQ team members

jobs.description:
Description

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager - Tech who is passionate about building world-class customer experiences beyond the Prime Video app. In this role, you'll own and shape the strategic direction for how millions of WW customers discover, engage with, and return to Prime Video through outbound marketing channels, messaging apps, and emerging AI surfaces.

You'll obsess over the end-to-end customer experience — designing communication programs that feel premium, intuitive, and worthy of the Prime Video brand. You'll develop a deep understanding of customer behavior across email, push notifications, WhatsApp, and new surfaces like AI platforms, then translate those insights into communication programs that feel timely, relevant, and delightful. You'll be highly informed by data and experimentation but apply high judgment to anticipate where customer attention is shifting and position Prime Video to meet them there.

Key job responsibilities

Vision & Strategy: Drive the long-term vision and strategy for Prime Video's off-app customer experience — defining how we show up across outbound channels, conversational surfaces, and emerging AI platforms
Customer Understanding: Develop a comprehensive understanding of customer lifecycle patterns, content consumption behaviors, and channel preferences to inform when, where, and how we reach customers
Leadership & Influence: Set the bar for product thinking across the team — mentor PMs, influence cross-org priorities, and represent the off-app experience perspective in senior leadership forums
Experience Design: Design and implement customer communication experiences that are premium, contextual, and consistent with the in-app experience — across email, push, WhatsApp, and new surfaces
Innovation: Pioneer new approaches to customer engagement across emerging surfaces including AI platforms, conversational interfaces, and agentic experiences — positioning Prime Video ahead of shifting customer behavior
Marketing Automation: Build and scale the systems and tooling that enable marketers to create, test, and optimize customer journeys without engineering dependency
Metrics & Experimentation: Define success metrics, build a robust experimentation roadmap, and drive continuous optimization across all channels and lifecycle stages
Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, science, marketing, UX design, and business intelligence teams to bring experiences to market in a complex, fast-paced environment

About The Team

Our vision is to establish Prime Video as the premium entertainment brand regardless of where customers engage with us. We meet customers where they are by expanding touchpoints across out-of-app surfaces, delivering compelling experiences that showcase our content and brand, and creating a seamless transition to stream. We contribute to the Prime Video vision by driving high-intent customer engagement into the Prime Video app and strengthening the Prime Video brand in off-app surfaces.

We oversee the Prime Video experiences across customer touchpoints off-app, including: organic & AI surfaces (traditional search and AI), conversational surfaces (WhatsApp), outbound (email and push notifications), A.com and social.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of end to end product delivery experience
8+ years of technical product or program management experience
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience technical product management
Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
Experience in MarTech delivering customer facing products in marketing channels

jobs.description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

HackerOne Values

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed
and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure
by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together
by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

Position Summary

At HackerOne, great content starts with a great story. It’s how we make complex cybersecurity topics understandable, turn original research into insights people remember, and build trust with security leaders.

As our Content Marketing Manager, you’ll help find and tell those stories. You’ll lead key parts of our content program, including the HackerOne blog, annual research, search optimization, and editorial standards. You’ll work with experts across HackerOne to uncover interesting ideas, find the story in the data, and turn technical expertise into content that is clear, useful, and worth reading.

This role is part editor, part storyteller, and part content strategist. You’ll bring strong editorial judgment, curiosity, and an audience-first mindset to what we create, while using data, search insights, and AI tools to help our content reach the right people and make a measurable impact.

What You Will Do

Manage the HackerOne blog, including the editorial calendar, story development, publishing, optimization, and performance tracking.
Lead the development of HackerOne’s annual research and flagship reports, finding the strongest stories in our data and working with internal experts and partners to turn those insights into compelling narratives.
Find stories across HackerOne by interviewing subject matter experts, asking the right questions, and identifying perspectives that can strengthen our thought leadership.
Turn complex cybersecurity topics into clear, engaging content for security leaders without losing the substance or expertise behind them.
Help execute our answer engine optimization (AEO) and search engine optimization (SEO) strategy, using search data and audience insights to identify opportunities and improve content performance.
Maintain and apply HackerOne’s Style Guide to ensure our content is clear, consistent, and distinctly HackerOne.
Manage the content intake process, helping teams sharpen ideas, prioritize requests, and move strong stories from concept to publication.
Multiply the impact of our best stories by adapting content for campaigns, social media, and audience engagement.
Measure content performance and use those insights to understand what resonates with our audience and inform what we create next.
Use AI tools throughout the content process to support research, idea development, drafting, editing, optimization, and repurposing while maintaining strong human editorial judgment.

Minimum Qualifications

Excellent writing, editing, and interviewing skills, with strong editorial judgment and attention to detail.

Position Overview

The SVP of Sales and Marketing owns Dollamur’s full commercial engine — brand, demand generation, digital and e-commerce, product marketing, and all sales — and is accountable for turning brand and demand into booked revenue. This leader builds a high-performance commercial organization, holds marketing to pipeline and return on spend rather than impressions, gives sales the positioning and qualified demand it needs to win, and serves as Dollamur’s senior ambassador across the sports and Health and Safety markets. The successful candidate will be comfortable with group and interpersonal leadership challenges, maintaining positive momentum and working to motivate teams and organizations in a dynamic environment.

Commercial Strategy & Growth

Set and execute an integrated commercial strategy — sales, marketing, pricing, and channel — that delivers profitable growth in Wrestling, Gymnastics & Cheerleading, and Martial Arts & Fitness, while developing adjacent, emerging, and international markets.
Own the full funnel — awareness through quote, close, and retention — with single-point accountability for conversion at every stage.

Demand Generation, Digital & E-Commerce

Build a measurable demand engine across search, paid and organic social, email, and content, accountable to cost per qualified lead, pipeline, and return on ad spend.
Run the website and direct-to-consumer channel as commercial assets: traffic, conversion, merchandising, customer acquisition cost, and lifetime value.

Run a disciplined lead process (capture, scoring, routing, follow-up SLAs) jointly with sales, and hold agencies and vendors to defined deliverables and ROI.

Sales Leadership & Organization

Lead and develop the two VPs and the Head of Marketing against revenue, gross margin, operating income, and demand targets; build bench strength and succession.
Design the commercial structure — inbound, outbound, key accounts, inside, field, and dealer support — and build a team known for responsiveness, product knowledge, and being easy to do business with.
Design incentive compensation aligned to revenue, margin, and customer experience.

CRM, Analytics & Performance Management

Drive consistent CRM and marketing automation use across sales and marketing: pipeline management, forecast accuracy, campaign attribution, and data integrity.
Maintain a single source of truth for commercial reporting, with marketing-sourced pipeline and revenue reported alongside sales.
Set KPIs for every team, segment, and channel, and align forecasting and planning with Operations and Finance, including the S&OP process.

Market Intelligence, Partnerships & Industry Presence

Run an ongoing competitive intelligence discipline — competitors, pricing, service models, substitutes — and turn it into positioning, pricing guidance, and selling tools.
Build senior relationships with key customers, distributors, governing bodies, and strategic partners, and run athlete, coach, club, and influencer partnerships that convert reach into revenue.
Own event and trade-show strategy end to end with measured ROI, and direct PR and communications as Dollamur’s primary commercial spokesperson.

Financial Leadership & Executive Reporting

Manage the combined sales and marketing budget, shifting spend toward the highest-return channels, and mitigate commercial, brand, channel-conflict, and reputational risk.
Report regularly to the CEO, executive team, and Board on revenue, pipeline, brand health, competitive dynamics, and risks, with clear recommendations.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field required; MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive commercial leadership across both sales and marketing, preferably in sports manufacturing, consumer products, building materials, or a related industry.
Has owned a marketing function — brand, demand generation, and digital — while carrying a revenue number.
Proven revenue growth in B2B and B2C environments, including dealer or distributor channels and direct-to-consumer, leading complex inbound and outbound sales organizations.
Hands-on experience building and measuring a digital demand engine (paid media, search, e-commerce, attribution) and managing agencies to measurable outcomes.
Strong negotiation and partnership skills, with a record of defending premium positioning against discounting.
Advanced proficiency in CRM, marketing automation, and commercial analytics.

Commercially aggressive, analytically disciplined and accountable for results.
Strong brand and marketing judgment with an operator's focus on revenue, margin and ROI.
Exceptional communication and negotiation skills.

new_jobs.description:
We are obsessed with the hero's journey at JobNimbus. Every person has a hero's journey. Hermione Granger, James T. Kirk, Frodo Baggins, Anna & Elsa, Nacho Libre, and even YOU! This is our "call to adventure" to come check out JobNimbus. What do you have to lose? You might make a few new friends, learn about a sick new company doing some amazing things, and maybe you'll even land a new job!

Mission

Paid media is how most roofing contractors first discover JobNimbus. Your mission is to run it hands-on so every dollar we spend turns into demos that close, not just clicks or cheap form fills. That starts with the signal. You'll teach Google and Meta to find contractors who become customers by feeding real revenue outcomes back into the platforms. Then you'll make sure the leads they find don't get lost. Every paid lead should land in HubSpot with a clear source and reach a rep who can help. From there, you'll widen the engine. Google carries most of our paid demand today, and you'll change that by building Meta into a proven second channel and launching target-account campaigns on LinkedIn. The goal is growth that holds steady, even when one platform has a bad week.

What You'll Be Doing

Run Google Ads hands-on. Audit and restructure the account for yield, keep Performance Max under control, and roll out bidding changes carefully so lead flow stays steady while the algorithms learn.
Build Meta from the ground up. Launch lead ads, the Conversions API, lookalike and retargeting audiences, and a steady stream of contractor-focused video and UGC creative tests. Then bring a data-backed case for how far to scale it.
Optimize to revenue, not form fills. Send demo-held and closed-won outcomes back to Google and Meta so the platforms learn which leads turn into customers.
Own the tracking and lead flow. Partner with Marketing Ops so every paid lead lands in HubSpot with its source and routes to a rep. Keep spam, invalid traffic, and abandoned forms out of your conversion data.
Launch target-account campaigns. Build account-based audiences on LinkedIn and Meta with Sales Ops, and run enterprise campaigns alongside our Business Development team.
Own the budget. Plan spend by channel and campaign, pace it weekly, and move dollars toward what produces demos that close.
Test constantly. Run creative, audience, and landing page tests every month, log what you learn, and scale the winners.
Partner with Creative, Content, and Sales. Write clear creative briefs, team up on landing page tests, and use feedback from sales reps to sharpen targeting.
Tell the story in plain language. Send a weekly paid performance snapshot to your leader that explains what changed, why, and what's next.
Support growth into new markets. Launch geo-targeted campaigns as JobNimbus expands into new regions.

What Makes You The Hero For This Job

4+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads for lead generation, including Performance Max, with results measured on pipeline or revenue
Hands-on Meta lead gen experience: lead ads, audience building, high-volume creative testing, and the Conversions API
Strong conversion tracking skills with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and offline conversion imports, plus the ability to find and fix broken tracking
Experience connecting ad platform leads to HubSpot so leads arrive with a source and route correctly
Comfortable owning a paid media budget and pacing spend weekly
Able to work full-time in our Lehi, Utah office

Superpowers

Customer Obsession: You want to know what makes a roofing contractor stop scrolling, click, and book a demo, and you go find out by listening to sales calls and reading the leads yourself.
Extreme Ownership: When a campaign stumbles, you're the first to say so. You own the fix, including the tracking, the lead flow, and the budget.
Self Awareness: You know where your paid media skills are deep and where they're still growing, and you ask for help or feedback early.
Proactive Learning: The platforms change every month and you keep up. You test new features, read the release notes, and bring back what works.
Team Commitment: You make Creative, Content, Marketing Ops, and Sales better partners by giving them clear briefs, fast answers, and credit for the wins.

Mentor

Matt Nelson - Specialist in hiring amazing people, lover of music, Connect Four, ping pong, tennis, pickleball, photography, celebrating birthdays, the Red Sox, and recruiting.

Roles & Responsibilities

new_jobs.title: Senior Director of Demand Generation
new_jobs.description:
We are obsessed with the hero's journey at JobNimbus. Every person has a hero's journey. Hermione Granger, James T. Kirk, Frodo Baggins, Anna & Elsa, Nacho Libre, and even YOU! This is our "call to adventure" to come check out JobNimbus. What do you have to lose? You might make a few new friends, learn about a sick new company doing some amazing things, and maybe you'll even land a new job!

Mission

JobNimbus helps roofing contractors run their businesses. Inbound is how most of them find us, so it’s our largest source of new business. Your mission is to turn inbound into a predictable revenue engine that the business, Sales and the board can plan around. That means owning the full journey, from the first ad impression to the signed contract. Every lead gets captured, routed to the right rep and followed up quickly. Demand doesn’t hinge on one platform or one bidding algorithm, so you’ll build paid, organic, AI search, referral, partner and event channels that grow together. Success is measured in demos held and closed-won revenue, not lead counts. You’ll also extend that engine into new territory: a pipeline program for mid-market and enterprise accounts with our BD and Sales teams, and a repeatable playbook for launching JobNimbus in new regional markets. Do this well and you’ll have built the growth foundation for JobNimbus’s next stage, and a team that keeps it running.

What You'll Be Doing

Own inbound from lead to closed-won. Diagnose the funnel by source and stage, present a plan of attack in your first few weeks, and take accountability for demos held, conversion and new ARR alongside Sales.
Fix the foundation. Make sure every form, ad platform and lead source lands in HubSpot as a lead, routed to the right rep within an agreed speed-to-lead SLA. Partner with RevOps so every demo has a source and leadership sees one trusted inbound number.
Diversify and improve paid performance. Launch and scale Meta as our next paid engine, grow organic, AI search, referral, partner and event channels, and direct agencies so paid search optimizes to demos held and closed-won, not cheap form fills.
Build new growth engines. Partner with BD and Sales on target-account advertising, ABM, and field and partner events for enterprise pipeline. Lead marketing for regional market launches, starting with Phoenix.
Lead the team. Develop marketers and agency partners, and brief Creative, Content, Events and Product Marketing so their work is measured against pipeline.

What Makes You The Hero For This Job

8+ years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, including 3+ years leading teams and agencies. SaaS with high-velocity SMB inbound is strongly preferred.
You’ve owned a pipeline or revenue number alongside a sales team.
You’ve diagnosed and reversed a declining inbound funnel, and you can show before-and-after results through closed-won.
You’ve moved real budget and lead volume into a new paid channel, ideally Meta, and can show the results.
You have hands-on depth in Google Ads and Meta: value-based bidding, offline conversions, the Conversions API, Performance Max, and invalid-traffic controls.
You’re fluent in HubSpot or an equivalent marketing automation platform and CRM: lifecycle stages, lead scoring, routing and attribution.
You’ve built organic or content channels that produced pipeline, not just traffic.
You’re data-first: every number you present traces back to a real report.

Superpowers

Customer Obsession. Every campaign starts with the contractor. You learn how roofers actually buy software: what they search for at 9 p.m. after a long day on a roof, what makes them book a demo, and what makes them sign. Then you build the funnel around that, not around cheap clicks.
Extreme Ownership. You own the number, not just the MQLs. That means demos held, conversion and new ARR. When a lead falls through the cracks, a form isn’t connected, or a channel stalls, you’re the first to notice, you fix it, and you tell leadership before they have to ask.
Self Awareness. You know the difference between a story and a result, and you won’t call MQL growth a win when deals are falling. You ask for feedback from Sales, your team and your agencies, own your misses, and change course quickly when the data says you’re wrong.
Proactive Learning. Paid platforms, AI search and buyer behavior change every quarter, and you stay ahead of them. You test, measure and iterate fast, and you treat JobNimbus product knowledge as a competitive edge, because the better you know the product, the better you can sell it.
Team Commitment. Great demand gen is a team sport. You get Sales, RevOps, Creative, Content and Events working toward the same definitions and the same pipeline goals. You develop the people on your team, hold agencies to a high bar, and celebrate wins together.

Mentor

Matt Nelson - Specialist in hiring amazing people, lover of music, Connect Four, ping pong, tennis, pickleball, photography, celebrating birthdays, the Red Sox, and recruiting.

COMPANY:
Humacyte Inc (Nasdaq: HUMA) is developing a disruptive biotechnology platform to deliver universally implantable bioengineered human tissues, advanced tissue constructs, and organ systems designed to improve the lives of patients and transform the practice of medicine. The Company develops and manufactures acellular tissues to treat a wide range of diseases, injuries, and chronic conditions. Humacyte’s initial opportunity, a portfolio of Acellular Tissue Engineered Vessel (ATEVs), is currently approved for use in vascular trauma repair and is in late-stage clinical trials targeting multiple other applications including AV access for hemodialysis and peripheral arterial disease. Preclinical development is also underway in coronary artery bypass grafts, pediatric heart surgery, treatment of type 1 diabetes, and multiple novel cell and tissue applications. Humacyte’s 6mm ATEV for AV access in hemodialysis was the first product candidate to receive the FDA’s Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation and has also received FDA Fast Track designation. Humacyte’s 6mm ATEV for urgent arterial repair following extremity vascular trauma also received the RMAT designation. For more information, visit www.Humacyte.com .
